reason: B is the better proposal because W solid-solution strengthening of a refractory BCC alloy is physically plausible and is qualitatively supported by the reported high-temperature strength retention of W-containing MoNbTaW. A is more quantitative, but its central claim of coherent Zr-rich nanoprecipitates is unsupported—and is undermined by its cited Zr-alloy evidence showing single-phase BCC solid solutions—so its specified heat treatment and strength gain lack a sound basis.
